hokkaido_totals.year_label_en: 2025 crop year (beets harvested autumn 2025; sugar from that crop processed Oct 2025 - May 2026)

factory_count_note: As of the Hokkaido govt 「北海道の畑作をめぐる情勢」(R8/2026年11月, part 2, PDF page 6 / printed p.34) map 'てん菜糖工場分布図(３社７工場)': 3 companies, 7 beet sugar factories. Down from 3社8工場 (MAFF 甘味資源部会 資料 220909-17, p.1, 2022). The closed one is 北海道糖業 本別製糖所: per the same Hokkaido doc (table てん菜糖生産量(産糖量ベース)の推移, note 3) from 令和5砂糖年度 beets received at 北糖本別事業所 are processed at 北糖北見製糖所 and ニッテン芽室製糖所; Nitten history page: 2023 芽室製糖所での北海道糖業（本別）からの受託製造を開始. Nitten 芽室製糖所 is NOT closed - it was the largest producer in the 2025 crop (171,826 t sugar). Note: 日本甜菜製糖 renamed to 株式会社ニッテン in 2026 (Nitten history page).

season.harvest_months: October-November (ALIC: GW前後に植付けされ、その年の10～11月に収穫; MAFF pamphlet calendar: 収穫・搬出 in Oct-Nov, '収穫は10月')
season.processing_months: Slicing (截断) starts early-mid October and ends late December to mid March; sugar boiling (製糖) at the largest plant continued to early May. 2025 crop actuals: 截断 start 10/4-10/15; 截断 end 12/22 (士別) to 3/10 (中斜里); 製糖 end 12/23 (士別) to 5/4 (芽室).

notes: Latest completed crop = 令和7年産 (2025). Hokkaido govt also published a forecast for 令和8年産 (2026): 46,401.35 ha, 3,311,000 t (生産見込数量 as of 8/20, published 2026-09-15; https://www.pref.hokkaido.lg.jp/fs/1/3/2/1/4/8/6/1/_/02%20%E7%94%9F%E7%94%A3%E8%A6%8B%E8%BE%BC%E6%95%B0%E9%87%8FR8.pdf, p.1). Not final; do not mix with actuals.
Region values are Hokkaido govt (14 振興局) survey figures; they sum to the 47,965.49 ha / 3,194,632.98 t total. Soya (宗谷) has no beet. Tokachi 44.4% and Okhotsk 40.6% of area.
Municipality-level (市町村別) area/harvest for 2025 is also available in the same Hokkaido PDF, pages 2-4 (table '2 市町村別'), if a choropleth by municipality is wanted.
ALIC jd1-2 columns: 年産 labels 26..30 = 平成, 元..7 = 令和. 産糖量 for 20年産 onward excludes beet sugar-equivalent of juice for bioethanol (注1).
The Hokkaido doc table 'てん菜糖生産量(産糖量ベース)の推移' labels years as 砂糖年度 but its R7 values (e.g. total 491千t) match the 令和7年産 factory actuals.

Per-factory 2025-crop sugar output (Hokkaido govt PDF p.1): 芽室 171,826.18 t (includes 本別-received beets processed under contract, 29,989.50 t); 美幌 49,300.00; 士別 33,051.70; 中斜里 126,010.01; 清水 41,600.01; 北見 40,046.94 (includes 6,430.52 from 本別); 道南 29,072.17. Total 490,907.01 t.
